The claim states that the sample is composited into the pixel accumulator using the front-to-back over operator. The evidence in Source [S4] explicitly describes this process: it initializes pixel color and opacity, iterates through the volume (implied near to far based on the ray direction and standard volume rendering logic described), and applies the standard over operator formula: `pixel_color[0:3] = pixel_color[0:3] + (1 - pixel_color[3]) * np.array(color_and_opacity[0:3]) * color_and_opacity[3]`. This formula is the mathematical definition of the front-to-back over operator in volume rendering. Therefore, every fact in the claim is supported by the evidence.
